patterns.note: Content sections alternate between full-width imagery or dark overlays and contained text blocks, creating a balanced visual rhythm.
Consistent use of uppercase for all major headings, sub-headings, and labels, conveying a sophisticated and structured tone.
A high-contrast, monochromatic palette of white, various shades of gray, and black is used throughout, with imagery providing the primary color accents.
The hero section features a dramatic scroll-triggered reveal where an initial dark overlay lifts to expose a full-bleed background image/video as the user scrolls down.
Prominent, full-width hero section that acts as a brand introduction, followed by a series of distinct content blocks detailing various aspects of the brand.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a video-hero effect where a dark, semi-transparent overlay initially covers a full-screen background image or video. As the user scrolls, this overlay animates upwards or fades out, revealing the full background content while the primary hero text and call-to-action remain fixed or parallax slightly over the revealing media.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining brand presence and navigation access throughout the user's scroll journey.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant headings (hero text is ~4-5x body, section titles ~2-3x body) with consistent uppercase styling, paired with readable body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy; generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around text blocks, contributing to a premium feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dramatic, scroll-triggered hero reveal, where a dark overlay lifts to expose a full-bleed, high-quality image or video, immediately establishes a sense of luxury and immersion. This, combined with the elegant, uppercase typography, creates a sophisticated and memorable brand introduction.
